**Tutorial**

#Installing Packages

```{r}
install.packages("related", repos="http://R-Forge.R-project.org")
install.packages("adegenet")
```


#Observed and Expected Heterozgosity

```{r}

```

```{r}
head(h_e)

```

#Estimating F_is

```{r}
Fis_per_locus <- 1 - (h_o / h_e)
Fis_per_locus
mean(Fis_per_locus, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
hwe_results
```


#Convert to related accepted file format

```{r}
gt_filtered <- vcfR::extract.gt(vcf, element = "GT")
```

#Reframe into dataframe of integers

```{r}
# sample ids
sample_ids <- colnames(gt_filtered)

gt_to_alleles <- function(gt_vector) {
  # split "0/1" or "0|1" into two integer alleles, returning a 2-column matrix (samples x 2 alleles)
  allele1 <- integer(length(gt_vector))
  allele2 <- integer(length(gt_vector))
  
  for (i in seq_along(gt_vector)) {
    g <- gt_vector[i]
    if (is.na(g) || g %in% c("./.", ".", "./", "/.")) {
      allele1[i] <- 0
      allele2[i] <- 0
    } else {
      parts <- as.integer(strsplit(g, "[/|]")[[1]])
      allele1[i] <- parts[1] + 1L    # shift: 0->1 (ref), 1->2 (alt)
      allele2[i] <- parts[2] + 1L
    }
  }
  cbind(allele1, allele2)
}

allele_list <- vector("list", nrow(gt_filtered))

for (v in seq_len(nrow(gt_filtered))) {
  allele_list[[v]] <- gt_to_alleles(gt_filtered[v, ])
}

# combine: each element is (n_samples x 2); bind column-wise
allele_matrix <- do.call(cbind, allele_list)

# add individual IDs as the first column
coancestry_input <- data.frame(IndID = sample_ids, allele_matrix,
                               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# column names: IndID, L1_a, L1_b, L2_a, L2_b, ...
locus_names <- paste0(rep(paste0("L", seq_len(nrow(gt_filtered))),
                          each = 2),
                      rep(c("_a", "_b"), nrow(gt_filtered)))
colnames(coancestry_input) <- c("IndID", locus_names)
```

#Preview dataframe structure

```{r}
coancestry_input[1:5, 1:7]
```

#Calculate Coancesty Metrics & Print

```{r}
kin_results <- related::coancestry(
  genotype.data = coancestry_input,
  wang          = 1,      # 1 = compute; 0 = skip
  dyadml        = 1,
  quellergt     = 1
)

head(kin_results$relatedness)
```

#save kinresults as CSV

```{r}
write.csv(kin_results$relatedness, file = "/home/group/bioe-591-genomics/students/owenkanter/kinship/data/relatedness_output.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

**Homework**

#Load in ngsRelate and coancestry relatedness

```{r}
ngsrelateout <- read.table("/home/group/bioe-591-genomics/students/owenkanter/kinship/data/Inca_MaxMissing10.out", header = TRUE)

relatedness <- read.csv("/home/group/bioe-591-genomics/students/owenkanter/kinship/data/relatedness_output.csv", header = TRUE)
```

# Create summary stats table

```{r}
# Creating a function that produces desired table of summary stats
summary_stats <- function(x) {
  c(
    Mean = mean(x),
    SE = sd(x)/sqrt(length(x)),
    Median = median(x),
    Q25 = quantile(x, 0.25),
    Q75 = quantile(x, 0.75)
  )
}


# Create a wrapper to run summary stats across multiple columns
run_summary <- function(df, cols, dataset_name) { # Apply summary stats to each column listed for each dataset
  res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(df[cols], summary_stats)) # Creating single table from results
  res <- as.data.frame(res) # Create a data frame from results
  res$column <- rownames(res) # Retain column names
  res$dataset <- dataset_name # Add column with dataset name
  rownames(res) <- NULL
  return(res)
}

# Setting inputs for the function for ngs relate, chose to summarize rab, (F_a) inbreeding coefficient, inbreeding relatedness
  cols_ngsrelate <- c("rab", "theta", "KING")
    
# Setting inputs for the related::coancestry, wan, dyadml, quellergt
  cols_relatedness <- c("wang", "dyadml", "quellergt")

# Apply summary stats to the both datasets
  summary_ngsrelate <- run_summary(ngsrelateout, cols_ngsrelate, "ngsRelate")
  summary_relatedness <- run_summary(relatedness, cols_relatedness, "related")

# Create Combined summary table and print table
  combined_summary <- rbind(summary_ngsrelate, summary_relatedness)
  combined_summary
```

#Editing the table

```{r}
# Renaming columns by creating a vector with new names
  new_names <- c(
    "Q25.25%" = "Q25",
    "Q75.75%" = "Q75",
    "column" = "Relatedness Estimator",
    "dataset" = "Analysis Package"
  )

# Applying new column names to the combined_summary data frame
  colnames(combined_summary)[colnames(combined_summary) %in% names(new_names)] <-   new_names[colnames(combined_summary)[colnames(combined_summary) %in% names(new_names)]]

#Reorder the columns
  combined_summary <- combined_summary[, c("Relatedness Estimator", "Analysis Package","Mean", "SE", "Median", "Q25", "Q75")]
  
#Print Output  
  combined_summary
```

# Creating png from table

```{r}
# Install gt for constructing table
  install.packages("flextable")
  install.packages("webshot2")

# Load gt
  library(flextable)
  library(webshot2)

# Ajusting table, reducing decimals, aligning columns, and adjusting font
  summary_table_final <- flextable(combined_summary) %>%
    set_table_properties(layout = "autofit") %>%
    align(j = c("Relatedness Estimator", "Analysis Package","Mean", "SE", "Median", "Q25", "Q75"), align = "center", part = "all") %>%
    fontsize(size = 12, part = "all") %>%
    font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
    bold(part = "header")

#Save image
  save_as_image(summary_table_final, "/home/group/bioe-591-genomics/students/owenkanter/kinship/data/summary_table_final.png")
```
